policy_name: Algorithmic Content Optimization Engine — Video Rating Policy (v2)
description: Evaluation policy for AI-generated YouTube Shorts dance videos. v2 rebalances toward audio and visual pacing, de-weights overt engagement bait, and adds script/curiosity mechanics. Score each criterion, sum to a weighted total, map to a distribution tier.
changelog_from_v1: audio_alignment 5 -> 15 (trending/rising sound is a primary distribution driver)
engagement_bait 20 -> 10 (overt typed-response bait is increasingly penalized)
hook_quality: added HQ-05 'You' hook (second-person framing in first 2s)
retention_and_loop: added RL-04 delayed resolution + RL-05 conflict phrasing (But/So)
visual_production: added VP-04 cut/motion frequency (a visual change every <= 2.5s)
audio_alignment: added AA-03 rising-sound / early-adopter bonus
added AF-05 brand-safety auto-fail (replaces vague cringe/brand-fit scoring with a hard boundary)

auto_fail_conditions.label: Standing Start
auto_fail_conditions.description: Frame 1 shows a static or near-static pose before movement begins.
auto_fail_conditions.result: Score overridden to 0. Video must be regenerated.

auto_fail_conditions.label: No On-Screen Text
auto_fail_conditions.description: No text overlay present in the first 2 seconds.
auto_fail_conditions.result: Hook and Engagement Bait categories both score 0.

auto_fail_conditions.label: Duration Violation
auto_fail_conditions.description: Video duration is below 13 seconds or above 20 seconds.

auto_fail_conditions.label: No Trending Audio
auto_fail_conditions.description: Audio track is not sourced from the approved trending audio pool.

auto_fail_conditions.label: Brand Safety Violation
auto_fail_conditions.description: Explicit content, hate speech, or any predefined brand-safety violation.
auto_fail_conditions.result: Score overridden to 0. Video must be regenerated.

hook_quality.description: First 1.5–2 seconds. The hook must arrest scroll behavior and target the viewer immediately.

criteria.label: Peak Motion in Frame 1
criteria.description: Frame 1 shows the dancer mid-peak movement, not a lead-in or static pose.

evaluation.pass: Frame 1 is a dynamic high-energy motion pose.
evaluation.fail: Frame 1 is static, fading in, or pre-movement.

criteria.label: High-Contrast Background
criteria.description: Background is visually stark (black, white, or single-color neon) to isolate the dancer.

evaluation.pass: Single solid or neon color, no visual noise.

criteria.label: Pattern Interrupt Element
criteria.description: A bold visual or textual element in the first 1.5s that breaks scroll momentum.

criteria.label: No Introductory Build-Up
criteria.description: Zero tolerance for fade-ins, title cards, logo animations, or any non-motion frame before the dance begins.

criteria.label: The 'You' Hook
criteria.description: On-screen text in the first 2s uses second-person framing ('You', 'Your') to target the viewer directly.

evaluation.pass: Opening on-screen text addresses the viewer in second person.
evaluation.fail: No second-person framing in the opening.

retention_and_loop.description: Length, loop engineering, pacing, payoff timing, and narrative tension to maximize rewatch.

criteria.label: Duration Sweet Spot
criteria.description: 13–15 seconds to maximize forced-rewatch retention above 100%.

criteria.label: Seamless Loop — Final Frame Match
criteria.description: Final frame blends into frame 1 (body position and camera within ~5° identical) for an invisible loop.

criteria.label: Consistent Pacing — No Dead Zones
criteria.description: No static or low-energy segments; energy uniform or escalating.

criteria.label: Delayed Resolution
criteria.description: The payoff promised in the first 2 seconds is withheld until the final ~15% of the video (≈ second 12–13).

evaluation.pass: Promised payoff is delivered only in the final ~15%.
evaluation.partial: Payoff delivered in the back half but earlier than the final 15%. Deduct 2.
evaluation.fail: Payoff delivered up front, or no setup/payoff structure.

criteria.label: Conflict Phrasing (But/So)
criteria.description: Script and multi-part on-screen text use contrast/conflict transitions ('But', 'However', 'Suddenly') rather than additive ones ('And', 'Also') to maintain narrative tension.

evaluation.fail: Additive-only phrasing, or no narrative transitions.

engagement_bait.description: Whether the video mechanically invites a typed comment — de-weighted in v2 because platforms penalize overt bait; balance with organic intrigue (see RL-04).

criteria.label: Typed-Response Question Present
criteria.description: An open-ended, polarizing, or completion-style on-screen question that demands a typed answer (emoji-only is a failure signal).

evaluation.pass: Specific, typed-response question (e.g. 'Name a song harder than this').

criteria.label: Question Visibility
criteria.description: The comment-bait text is legible for the full duration, not a brief flash.

criteria.label: Polarization Potential
criteria.description: The question/concept has a divisive or competitive angle that triggers disagreement.

visual_production.description: AI-generation quality, composition, and in-between visual pacing.

criteria.label: Dancer Isolation
criteria.description: Dancer is the sole visual focal point; no environmental distractions.

criteria.label: Reflective or Dynamic Outfit
criteria.description: Outfit catches and interacts with light dynamically.

criteria.label: Render Quality
criteria.description: Crisp 4K-equivalent with no AI artifact distortion in motion.

evaluation.pass: No artifacts, blur, or morphing during peak motion.
evaluation.partial: Minor artifacts in non-focal areas only. Deduct 2.
evaluation.fail: Visible distortion/morphing on dancer body or face.

criteria.label: Cut / Motion Frequency
criteria.description: A visual change (hard cut, fast zoom, heavy pan, or dramatic lighting shift) occurs at least every 2.5 seconds to hold attention.

evaluation.pass: A distinct visual change at least every 2.5s.
evaluation.fail: Static framing or changes slower than every 4s.

audio_alignment.description: Whether the audio is from the approved trending pool, rhythmically matched, and ideally a rising sound. v2 treats audio as a primary distribution driver.

criteria.label: Track Source — Trending Pool
criteria.description: Audio is from the approved trending pool (current Billboard Hot 100 or a recent major release).

evaluation.pass: Hot 100 top 20 or album released within 30 days.
evaluation.fail: Not trending or unlicensed original audio.

priority_tracks.title: The Fate of Ophelia
priority_tracks.note: Dominant Spotify streams — peak hype window

criteria.label: Beat Sync
criteria.description: Movement peaks align with audio beat drops or rhythmic accents.

evaluation.pass: Motion synced with at least 3 distinct beat hits.
evaluation.fail: Out of sync or background-only audio.

criteria.label: Rising Sound / Early Adopter
criteria.description: The chosen sound is rising/early in its lifecycle (not saturated), giving an early-adopter distribution edge.

metadata.description: Title, description, and hashtag strategy for discoverability.

criteria.label: Comment Bait Mirrored in Title
criteria.description: Title echoes the on-screen question to reinforce the loop in the browse feed.

evaluation.pass: Title includes the comment-bait question or a direct variant.
evaluation.fail: Generic title with no engagement prompt.

criteria.label: Hashtag Mix Ratio
criteria.description: 3-niche / 4-broad / 1+ audio-anchor ratio.

required_hashtag_categories.audio_anchor: dynamic — must match the approved track used

criteria.label: Description CTA
criteria.description: Description contains a call-to-action reinforcing the comment bait.

evaluation.pass: Contains a comment CTA (e.g. 'Drop the song you want next below').

scoring_engine.formula: sum of all earned points across all categories
scoring_engine.auto_fail_override: AF-01 and AF-05 override the total to 0. AF-02/03/04 zero their relevant category.

post_rating_action_map.score_85_to_100: Publish immediately. Post a follow-up optimized video within 48 hours to compound the Honeymoon Phase.
post_rating_action_map.score_65_to_84: Fix the lowest-scoring category before publishing.
post_rating_action_map.score_0_to_64: Do not publish. Regenerate using the ACOE prompt with auto-fail corrections applied first.
